name: bus
description: Eight 16-bit buses with 8 sources each (1086 components): a DEC over a window of a 16-bit counter selects a source, whose AND2s drive its rotation of the counter onto the bus, so each of the 128 bus links has 8 drivers; a wide OR reads each bus. About 70% of the output flips land on multi-driver links (cpu: about 13%), so it measures the counted path those links take (driver counts, the invalid check), which every other synthetic board skips.
